variants.text: Middle-aged man with short forward-styled hair, a clean-shaven face, and yellow-tinted round glasses, wearing dark high-collared outerwear.

Middle-aged male with an oval face, receding hairline, short forward-styled hair, and thin eyebrows. He is clean-shaven and wears yellow-tinted round glasses with dark, high-collared outerwear; a ring is visible on his finger.

Middle-aged male with an oval face, moderate soft tissue, and medium-height forehead. Features include a receding hairline at the temples, thin arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with upper-lid creases, a straight nose with a rounded tip, and a mouth with thin lips. He has short hair styled forward and is clean-shaven. He wears round glasses with yellow-tinted lenses, dark high-collared outerwear, and a ring on the finger resting against his cheek.

A middle-aged man with short hair combed forward, wearing yellow-tinted round glasses. He has a clean-shaven face and is wearing a dark, high-collared jacket or coat. He has a ring on his finger, which he is resting against his cheek.
